_about: Moon sites the new milestones use (Moon sites and milestones plan, section 2; rules in game-design.md, Rules for the new milestones). Types: rules/types.ts SitesFile. Each site is an existing terrain.json feature (feature), a pipeline feature by id (pipeline: { list, id }), or a provisional candidate (provisional, local, radiusM) until the pipeline (Phase 1, P1 to P4) confirms or replaces it. rockSuite names a suite in tuning.json instruments.xray.suites. Keys starting with _ are notes.

sites.name: NW crater
sites.note: Pipeline young-crater-nw (-850, -220): 150 m across, 8.6 m deep, darker ejecta (albedo ratio 0.96). Worn ('subdued'), not fresh: no fact may claim bright ejecta here. Radius from the pipeline (75 m).

sites.name: East crater
sites.note: Pipeline young-crater-east (-240, -130): fresh (depth/diameter 0.10, inner wall to 39 deg), rim radius 45 m, but its ejecta is not clearly brighter (1.01): no fact may claim bright ejecta here.

sites.name: SE crater
sites.note: Pipeline young-crater-se (200, 685), 1.16 km from the lander: fresh, the brightest ejecta of the young craters (1.09), radius 40 m. Replaces the plan's West crater candidate, which has no rim (Phase 1).

sites.name: Rolled boulder
sites.note: Placed by design: pipeline boulder-track-1, foot at (-240, -125) on East crater's floor, its track running up to the wall top at (-220, -35). In shadow the whole mission with the game's Sun path.

sites.name: Hydrogen-rich ground
sites.note: Placed by design: pipeline low-light-nw, centred on its inner point (-1105, -400), the point farthest inside the patch (about 25 m to its edge, 39 m to Rocky area 1's cold patch). Zone radius: tuning.milestones.hydrogenZoneRadiusM.

sites.name: Rocky area 1 cold patch
sites.note: Pipeline cold-trap-rocky-area-1: its permanent-shadow outline (52,600 m2). The cold rules find it from tuning.cold.zones 'Rocky area 1' (the rocky area feature).

sites.name: East cold trap
sites.note: Pipeline cold-trap-east (-130, 120): one 60 m LOLA pixel (PSR fraction 0.92), at the map's resolution limit; fact text must not give it a size.

sites.name: South cold trap
sites.note: Pipeline cold-trap-south (-970, 900): one 60 m LOLA pixel. Borderline: about 900 m2 never lit on the game's 5 m heights. Kept as a game site (decided in Phase 4).

sites.name: Permanently shadowed crater
sites.note: Counts as a cold trap for the survey (decided in Phase 0). Its zone is its permanent-shadow outline.
